[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
John Glasgow was recorded as an insured manufacturer in Anderston, parish of Barony, Lanarkshire, on 1 October 1788; the entry locates him on the south side of the village. On 29 March 1792, a second policy entry names John Glasgow, manufacturer, on the south side of Anderston's main street. The repeated name, occupation and locality support a provisional grouping, but do not prove the entries concern the same man. Glasgow-2871, whose recorded death is 3 April 1792, remains chronologically compatible with both policies; no evidence yet links him to Anderston. No age, family, exact trade, or subsequent identity is established.<ref>The London Archives: City of London, Sun Fire Office policy register, [https://discovery.nationalarchives.gov.uk/details/r/759aad01-4282-444a-bfa5-7650c4796bbd MS 11936/356/548623], 1 October 1788. Official Discovery catalogue description reviewed 12 November 2026; original policy not inspected, reported not digitised.</ref>
<ref>The London Archives: City of London, Sun Fire Office policy register, [https://discovery.nationalarchives.gov.uk/details/r/20a9024e-49f2-4786-b28b-842289523374 MS 11936/386/598338], 29 March 1792. Official Discovery catalogue description reviewed 12 November 2026; original policy not inspected, reported not digitised.</ref>

His birth is conservatively bounded before 1789 solely from the dated record. This is a record-derived upper bound, not his birth year; no age or birthplace is inferred.

== Research Notes ==
Glasgow-2871 remains a compatible candidate: his profile's recorded death is five days after the second policy, not before it. Pennsylvania-region context is neither a disproof nor a migration bridge. Glasgow-2870's 1769 death conflicts with the policy dates if accurate. The other John Glasgow newspaper/subscription drafts concern separate contexts and provide no Anderston connection. Inspect Barony/Anderston tax, land, trade and parish records and the policy originals before assessing same-man continuity or attaching a WikiTree profile.

[[Glasgow-2871|John Glasgow (Glasgow-2871)]] is a compatible candidate, not an identification. [[Glasgow-2870]] has the stated death conflict if its 1769 death is accurate. The policies do not name relatives; no parent, spouse or birth/death field is inferred.
